limitations: Distinct studies, methods and species are not pooled; generalization requires separate validation.

accepted_argument_records.name: Causal neural contributions constrain embodied mind models
premises: Site-dependent neural intervention changes reported face appearance or arousal/access markers.
Within-subject/sham/control contrasts make mere passive correlation an incomplete description.
bridge_principles: The intervention meaningfully affects the neural system relevant to the observed report/behavior.
Reports are defeasible evidence of experience; animal markers require additional validation.

accepted_argument_records.strongest_objection: Interventions may alter access/reporting, distributed routing or a posited interface without proving how experience is constituted.
accepted_argument_records.strongest_reply: An interface account must specify predictions for the observed content, site and state effects rather than merely accommodate them.
unresolved_issues: Specific substrate versus reporting contributions.
Generalization beyond tested conditions.
Distinctive model predictions.

accepted_argument_records.name: Neural dependence does not by itself settle ontology
premises: Causal modulation does not establish metaphysical identity.
Unresponsiveness and absent markers do not directly verify phenomenal absence.
Theory tests depend on biological and measurement assumptions.

accepted_argument_records.conclusion: Results constrain embodied models without uniquely selecting physicalism or brain independence, or licensing survival claims from failures of a neural theory.
accepted_argument_records.strongest_objection: An unspecified interface view can fit any data and lose predictive force against explicit neural mechanisms.
accepted_argument_records.strongest_reply: Require prospective contrasting predictions; logical underdetermination does not make alternatives equally supported.
unresolved_issues: Neural necessity across states.
Conscious versus unconscious processing.
Independent identity and survival criteria.

accepted_argument_records.name: Thinking animal and biological persistence
premises: A human organism is present.
It thinks.
There is exactly one relevant thinker and that thinker is the person.

accepted_argument_records.conclusion: The human person is that organism; a disembodied copy alone does not preserve it.

premises: Assume an agent knows the relevant harms and feasible alternatives, can prevent them and is perfectly good.

A hypothetical animal does not establish an actual event.
Free-will and soul-making originals beyond the inspected discussions remain gaps.

conclusions.assertion: Finite significance, worthwhile endurance, necessity of endurance and actual cosmic purpose are distinct. Same-person continuation can enhance goods under value and continuity conditions; mere endless duration and purpose labels do not establish value or actuality.

limitations: Different from establishing either premise.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Wolf proposes active, caring engagement with independently worthy objects; pleasure alone is insufficient on her account.
limitations: Objective worth is a philosophical commitment, not an independently demonstrated value ontology.

limitations: Within-life meaning cannot simply replace the user’s enduring/cosmic target.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Fischer rejects inevitable unattractiveness through mixed activities, suitably distributed repeatable pleasures, and tolerable changes of character.
limitations: Possible desirability is not necessary goodness, objective meaning, physical feasibility or actual immortality.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Actual benefits within a finite interval can ground finite significance under an explicit value premise without answering why a cosmos exists or whether its subjects endure.
limitations: Conditional non-erasure premise; rejects neither cosmic-purpose question nor comparative enduring value.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Keeping the same persons in worthwhile relationships and projects could preserve goods lost on extinction and add significance; it does not follow that every enduring life is better.
limitations: Assumes same subjects, worthwhile content, non-dominating costs, and an appropriate comparison rule.

accepted_claim_records.statement: The necessity thesis needs a further principle that loss of all enduring bearers or recognition defeats every relevant kind of significance, not merely future continuation.
limitations: Principle remains disputed; calling the target ultimate cannot settle the value dispute by stipulation.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Williams argues that enduring human life threatens categorical motivation through an impoverished relation to the world, not merely an unpleasant feeling of boredom.
limitations: Source attribution only; claimed necessity remains contested. Replaces earlier project-only exhaustion reconstruction after original inspection.

accepted_claim_records.statement: A strictly timeless foundation cannot acquire experiences in sequence in the same respect; temporal persons or whole-history inclusion require distinct relations.

limitations: Inherited model constraint; does not prove such grounding impossible.

accepted_claim_records.statement: A universe containing conscious life and a universe intended to produce conscious life are distinct hypotheses.
limitations: Outcome alone supplies no observed designer preference or intended domain.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Purposeful creation can explain a role conditional on agency, end and causal/grounding link, but the worth of that role needs a normative premise.
limitations: Purpose does not automatically entail beneficence or authority.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Specified developmental and preserving purposes face different conditional tests concerning deprivation, opportunity and same-subject preservation.
limitations: No completed distribution or cosmic prevalence test; counterexamples require inclusion in the declared domain.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Williams grounds reasons to avoid death in categorical desires that motivate continuing life; death can be bad at a particular time even if endless life is undesirable.
limitations: No inference that every additional period is harmful or that death is always good; categorical desire can persist through unpleasant times.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Williams separates being the same person from a future life appropriately related to present aims; psychologically disjoint survival can meet the first condition while failing the second.
limitations: Not a claim that every character change destroys numerical identity; the prospective relation and his stronger conclusions remain disputed.

accepted_argument_records.name: Enduring significance: necessity versus enhancement
premises: Relationships, understanding and achieved goods can be worth preserving.
Specified continuation retains the same subjects and relevant goods.
Additional worthwhile experience is available without overriding harm.
bridge_principles: Comparative enhancement needs a defensible value ordering.
Necessity additionally needs total loss to defeat all significance in the selected domain.

accepted_argument_records.name: Williams on categorical desire and immortal life, with Fischer’s reply
accepted_argument_records.position: Inspected original challenge and reply, with project adjudication
premises: Williams: categorical desires can give present reasons to continue, independently of merely avoiding frustration.
Williams: an adequate immortal prospect must preserve the person and relate appropriately to the aims motivating survival.
Williams argues extended fixed-character life undermines motivation, while disjoint or radically accumulated lives fail to solve the appropriate-relation problem.
bridge_principles: The author’s modal step generalizes from conditions of recognizably human character to endless human existence; this remains contested.
A burden about appropriate prospective concern is distinct from numerical identity and from objective worth.
accepted_argument_records.conclusion: Williams supplies a stronger challenge than mere hedonic boredom, but its universal necessity is not established by the present comparison; conditional worthwhile endurance remains open.
accepted_argument_records.strongest_objection: Fischer allows varied activities, appropriately spaced repeatable pleasures, and acceptable character development; absorbed attention need not eliminate ownership. These contest inevitable exhaustion and indiscriminate identity-loss claims.
accepted_argument_records.strongest_reply: A strengthened Williams-side response asks whether renewal preserves genuine engagement and prospective reasons rather than simply suppressing awareness of impoverishment. Occasional pleasantness does not settle that question, and every experience being owned does not by itself establish an adequate relation to present aims.
unresolved_issues: Whether human categorical projects necessarily exhaust under all relevant immortal arrangements
Whether relational development can renew motivation while preserving identity and appropriate concern
Fischer’s repeatability/variety response does not alone establish objective worth or infinite resources
Williams addresses endless human life; application to strict timeless foundation or transformed persons needs additional premises

accepted_argument_records.name: Cosmic purpose and normative worth
accepted_argument_records.position: Strong purpose account with bridge audit
premises: An agent intends a stated end for a specified cosmic domain.
Its causal or grounding contribution explains why that domain has relevant features.
The end and agent-person relation are normatively worthwhile.
bridge_principles: Intentional explanation requires independent warrant for intention and constraints.
Authorship supplies a purpose relation, not worth by definition.
accepted_argument_records.conclusion: A worthy intentional relation can add cosmic significance conditionally; observed conscious production alone does not establish it.
accepted_argument_records.strongest_objection: Arbitrary or harmful ends would still be purposes; a timeless agent model owes coherent intention; designer premises remain unsupported.
accepted_argument_records.strongest_reply: Specify a loving creator-person relation and whole-history intention, or temporal agency; assess these with the same standards as rival primitive laws and value commitments.
unresolved_issues: Actual intention; agency model; normative foundation; domain; goodness and authority deferred

accepted_argument_records.name: Simple subject through qualitative change

That fact requires an immaterial essential part.
accepted_argument_records.conclusion: A soul is the candidate identity bearer.
accepted_argument_records.strongest_objection: Epistemic underdetermination does not entail an immaterial entity; deny further-fact premise or specify a physical/causal identity rule.

unresolved_issues: Short essay does not resolve all technical objections.
A surviving soul and continuing experience require additional persistence/activation premises; simplicity is not immortality.

accepted_argument_records.name: Enlarged first-person history beyond bodily life

A defended relation unifies those portions as the same person.
bridge_principles: Ordered content can be grounded without successive changes in the foundation.
An explicit criterion—not resemblance alone—licenses same-subject attribution.
accepted_argument_records.conclusion: M2 or enlargedM3 could satisfy H-S with foundation-level H-T.
accepted_argument_records.strongest_objection: The asserted ownership/extension may restate survival; a universal knower can preserve a finite life without the person continuing.
accepted_argument_records.strongest_reply: Treat subjectivity and individuation as substantive ontology with identifiable constraints; this blocks dismissal by definition but adds explanatory/evidential costs.
unresolved_issues: No observation here establishes enlarged history.
Strict organism criterion rejects disembodied extension unless same-organism relation defended.
Timeless individual model must explain non-successive awareness; the temporal-individual model does not solve that separate issue.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Leibniz states a PSR for true or existent facts and distinguishes necessary truths from contingent truths.
alternative_explanations: Author attribution does not establish the premise’s metaphysical truth.
limitations: Bennett modernization; universal PSR truth remains disputed.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Leibniz argues that even an infinite sequence of contingencies lacks its ultimate reason internally and concludes to a necessary substance.
alternative_explanations: Author attribution does not establish the premise’s metaphysical truth.
limitations: External explanation, necessity and concrete-substance steps require defense; not a temporal-beginning argument.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Leibniz separately attributes unity, perfection, understanding and will to the foundation, with choice governed by the best.
alternative_explanations: Author attribution does not establish the premise’s metaphysical truth.
limitations: These additional commitments are not established merely by calling a foundation necessary.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Collins presents fine-tuning as comparative support over an atheistic single-universe hypothesis, explicitly short of proof or an all-things-considered verdict.
alternative_explanations: Author attribution does not establish the premise’s metaphysical truth.
limitations: Abridged original; required probability appendix absent.

accepted_claim_records.statement: In Boethius V.6, Philosophy contrasts whole possession of life with endless sequential existence and places divine priority in simplicity rather than earlier duration.
limitations: Historical argument attribution; “single moment” in this translation is read with its explicit contrast to temporal succession, not as a coordinate instant.

accepted_claim_records.statement: A universe containing conscious life and a universe intended to produce conscious life are distinct hypotheses.
limitations: Outcome alone supplies no observed designer preference or intended domain.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Specified developmental and preserving purposes face different conditional tests concerning deprivation, opportunity and same-subject preservation.
limitations: No completed distribution or cosmic prevalence test; counterexamples require inclusion in the declared domain.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Craig grounds value in God’s nature and obligation in commands from a qualified authority; reasons for commands need not themselves constitute obligations.
source_locators: responses on qualified authority, values and duties
limitations: Not an established moral or metaphysical truth.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Craig permits contingent commands consistent with essential goodness, correcting his earlier necessary-command formulation.
limitations: Not an established moral or metaphysical truth.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Howard-Snyder grants inculpable nonbelief for argument and proposes prima facie reasons to postpone explicit relationship: freely owning or improving dispositions to love, including already well-disposed seekers; he does not demand perfect love before disclosure.
limitations: His permission criterion allows a means no worse than alternatives, not only logical necessity.
No actual divine reason or population psychology established.

accepted_claim_records.statement: Howard-Snyder limits his account to temporary nonbelief, concedes cultural distribution remains unaddressed, and allows a sufficiently fitting seeker to escape his objection while contesting our ability to identify one. Note18 further concedes that his sketched reason fails when the seeker recognizes deficient love and strongly desires improvement.
limitations: Earlier inculpability framework; not a direct reply to Schellenberg2025.
The author’s cultural illustration is not independently established history.

constraints.title: Scoped gate
constraints.rule: Use accept_scoped only for a bounded reviewed-record dependency map and conditional synthesis. Preserve all open coverage groups.

constraints.title: Source and model asymmetry
constraints.rule: Mark each matrix cell as inspected original, secondary attribution, project reconstruction or uninspected variant; use same C1–C6 standards.
constraints.gate_effect: No broad strongest-family ranking before P1 original-defender repair or an explicit narrower comparison.

constraints.title: Nine components
constraints.rule: Assess H-F/U/B/S/T/P/I/G/A separately with evidence IDs, bridge premises, scope and sensitivity. Task-local unresolved labels are not cumulative priors or equal support.
constraints.gate_effect: Any collapsed worldview score or automatic transfer requires revision.

constraints.title: Three judgments
constraints.rule: Keep record reliability, inference strength and component confidence separate. Reliable reporting is not event verification; accurate philosophy attribution is not premise truth.

constraints.title: Common-foundation positive case
constraints.rule: Construct the strongest proposal linking experience, existence, shared lawfulness, enduring personal significance and moral relations through stated grounding, identity, value and intention premises. Preserve possible unification gains.
constraints.gate_effect: Do not dismiss cumulative explanatory value merely because likelihoods are uncalibrated; do not count shared premises repeatedly.

constraints.title: Strongest countercase
constraints.rule: Combine actual neural dependence, unresolved timing/access, selection/cultural variation and optional PSR/modal/value/authority bridges with developed impersonal and plural alternatives.
constraints.gate_effect: Do not infer each case is explained by naming a possible mechanism, or that unknown likelihoods imply equal credibility.

constraints.title: Quantitative restraint
constraints.rule: Do not pool cases/samples or produce posterior numbers without defined denominators, disjointness, hypotheses, likelihoods and prior sensitivity. Qualitative unequal expectations need stated warrants too.
constraints.gate_effect: Missing opportunities are unknown, never automatically failures or successes.

constraints.title: Citation and search limits
constraints.rule: Retain frozen cutoff2026-09-11, English/accessible-translation scope and actual public-web methods. Distinct title queries are bounded discovery, not complete cited-by indexes.
constraints.gate_effect: No claim of exhaustive/systematic-review completion or historical reranking repair.

constraints.title: Future version control
constraints.rule: New original data or repaired claims need separate author/reviewer review; preserve accepted versions and mark affected dependent conclusions stale where changed.
constraints.gate_effect: T16–T18 drafts remain subject to joint R18 and G3; G2 is not final synthesis approval.

constraints.title: Repair triggers
constraints.rule: At T16 contract map every stronger intended conclusion to the gap that blocks it. Before T17/T18 claim that conclusion, complete its repair with review or explicitly withhold it.
constraints.gate_effect: Mandatory explicit adjudication; generic boilerplate caveats do not license a full comparison verdict.

component_requirements.label: Conscious fundamentality
component_requirements.required_boundary: Irreducibility or a necessary ground does not establish one universal subject; primitive ontology and actual dependence relation need argument.

component_requirements.label: Universal conscious whole
component_requirements.required_boundary: Subject individuation and common-world mapping remain substantive; shared motifs or one designer do not establish numerical experiential unity.

component_requirements.label: Brain independence
component_requirements.relevant_routes: NDE timing/information proposals and neural intervention constraints.
component_requirements.required_boundary: Brain influence is not the negation of every independence proposal; absent measurement is not absent processing. Need specified bearer/process and discriminating observations.

component_requirements.label: Personal survival
component_requirements.relevant_routes: Identity models and conditional anomalous/perception evidence.
component_requirements.required_boundary: Same-subject subjectivity beyond irreversible bodily death is separate from resuscitation and record preservation. Do not weaken the endpoint or identity standard.

component_requirements.label: Timelessness
component_requirements.required_boundary: Absence of external time parameter and reported altered duration do not establish absence of intrinsic succession in an actual bearer.

component_requirements.label: Preservation
component_requirements.required_boundary: Specify what persists: record, value, relation or subject. Fidelity of record is not itself H-S.

component_requirements.label: Intention
component_requirements.required_boundary: Production is not intended production; specify prior ends, level of agent and comparative expectations. Local designer does not imply purpose of containing cosmos.

component_requirements.label: Foundational goodness
component_requirements.relevant_routes: Normative premises, suffering/hiddenness and possible restoration.
component_requirements.required_boundary: Declared purposes can be indifferent or harmful; test exact goodness/love commitments. Compensation does not by itself justify permitting harm.

component_requirements.label: Moral authority
component_requirements.relevant_routes: Grounding matrix, divine nature/command, naturalist and reconstructed alternatives.
component_requirements.required_boundary: Consciousness, unity, creation, power and endurance do not automatically supply binding reasons; absent primary rival defenders prohibits broad elimination claims.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: Strongest disputed named NDE case, chosen explicitly by criterion in T16; show a second candidate if strength ordering ambiguous.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: All nine components; do not pick weakest case simply to protect conclusion.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: All retrospective cases/narratives, including retrospective community arm, retaining truly prospective observations at their real denominators.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: H-B/S direct empirical support versus independent conceptual H-F/I and neural constraints.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: Contributions whose sample/event dependence is uncertain.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: Whether any supposed convergence survives without IANDS/Liège and common-case multiplicity.

required_sensitivity_tests.vary: Psychological, organism and simple-subject identity criteria; strict identity versus prudential continuity; M1–M4.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: H-S and H-P separately, plus meaning and victim-restoration consequences.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: Central endurance-required-for-value, unity-to-obligation and consciousness-to-authority bridge premises.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: H-A/G/I versus preserved finite or enduring value claims; no moral nihilism assumed.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: Global PSR, epistemic-to-metaphysical bridge and life-valuing designer preferences one at a time.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: Necessary-ground, H-F/U and H-I/G routes without erasing independent evidence.

required_sensitivity_tests.remove: Strongest selected neural intervention or report-to-experience proxy; test independence model with actual predictive constraints retained.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: Symmetric sensitivity of countercase without concluding that weak measurement proves extracerebral experience.

required_sensitivity_tests.restrict: Only directly inspected positive original defenders and direct replies; exclude project reconstructions from claims about authors.
required_sensitivity_tests.track: Coverage asymmetry and whether any ranking depends on unreviewed weaker rival formulations.

G2_constraints.cumulative_status: Not assessed by G2; no numerical posterior or metaphysical verdict.

discrimination_needs.needed: Preregistered concealed-information opportunities with actual exposed/interviewed intersections, independent contemporaneous reports, patient-linked acquisition timing and specified process/exposure controls. Specify rival and independence-model differential expectations in advance.
Independent evidence of actual beyond-irreversible-death subjectivity and an explicitly defended identity criterion; a record or resuscitation recollection cannot substitute for either.
Defended modal/fundamentality or grounding premises plus constrained individuation and neural mapping; inspect relevant original rivals before comparative superiority.
Distinguish non-successive bearer from ordered contents; settle the relevant tensed-knowledge and grounding commitments. Phenomenological duration alone is not a discriminatory test.
Independently constrained candidate ends and differential expectations against specified impersonal models with observation selection; actual agency/grounding warrant beyond stating an intended role.

Defend normative value/authority and harm-permission bridges, with missing original moral alternatives/replies inspected for broader comparisons. Actual same-victim restoration is separate from consistency of a restoration story.
